主要内容: On February 1, 2012, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. announced the appointment of Jeffrey A. Cook as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Treasurer, effective February 9, 2012. Mr. Cook, who previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and a member of the board of directors of Presstek Inc., will not have an employment contract with Schweitzer-Mauduit. His compensation includes a base salary of $335,000, a target annual incentive bonus of 45% of base salary, and a long-term incentive bonus of 90% of base salary, payable in restricted stock. The company awarded him 5,000 shares of restricted stock with a four-year vesting period. The press release announcing this change was attached as Exhibit 99.1. Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. announced the appointment of senior management in a Form 8-K filing dated February 1, 2012. The report was signed by Mark A. Spears, who serves as Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer. The filing is in compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and the report was duly authorized by the registrant.
